content: Farse kawoy Qiroosi kawotida koyro laythan, nabiya Ermiyaasa baggara Goday odidaba polis. Farse kawoy Qiroosi ba kawotethaa giddon haysada yaagidi awaajana melanne he awaajuwa xaafidi wothana mela Goday iya wozana denthethis.
Farse kawoy Qiroosi haysada yaagees; “Goday, salo Xoossay ha sa7aa kawotethata ubbaa taw immis. Qassi Yihudan de7iya Yerusalaamen iyaw keethe keexana mela tana shuumis.
Xoossa asi gidida oonika yaa boo; iya Xoossay iyara gido! Hinte Yihudan de7iya Yerusalaame bidi, yan Yerusalaamen Godaa, Isra7eele Xoossaa keethaa zaaridi keexo.

Dumma dumma biittan de7iya asa ubbay Ayhudetape attidaysati bira, worqa, dumma dumma miishetanne mehe immidi maaddo; qassi Yerusalaamen de7iya Xoossaa keethaa banta dosan immiya imota bolla gujidi immo” yaagees.
Hessafe guye, Yihudanne Biniyaame koche halaqati, kahinetinne Leeweti, qassi Xoossay enta wozanaa denthethida ubbay Yerusalaamen Godaa Xoossaa keethaa keexanaw baanaw dendidosona.
Qassi enta shooron de7eysatika banta dosan immidaba bolla gujidi, birapenne worqafe oosetida miisheta, hara dumma dumma miishetanne mehe immidi, enta maaddidosona.
Hessa bolla kawoy Qiroosi Nabukadanaxoori Yerusalaamepe efidi ba eeqa keethan wothida Godaa keethaa miisheta immis.
Farse kawoy Qiroosi miisheta wothiya keetha halaqaa Mitirdaaxu taybisidi, Yihuda haariya Sesabisaara kushen wothis.
Simmida miisheta tayboy haysa; hastamu worqa shaate, mukulu bira shaate, laatamanne uddufun pil7o,
hastamu worqaa kere, oyddu xeetanne tammu bira kere mukulu hara dumma dumma miishe.
Worqa miishetanne bira miisheta tayboy kumethi ichashu mukulunne oyddu xeeta; Seesabisari Babiloonepe Yerusalaame simmiya wode di7ope simmida asaara ekidi yis.
